notes: Reference-only crops for two standalone transparent WebP assets requested from the supplied Fairlend composite. Crops must not be shipped or converted into final assets.

assets.label: Neumorphic baseplate landscape
assets.role: Transparent isometric landscape/map baseplate for web composition
assets.rationale: The map terrain, roads, water, trees, soft shadows, and miniature 3D model texture are raster-heavy and should be generated as a clean standalone asset, not rebuilt as UI.

generation.prompt: Use the reference crop only as style and composition guidance. Generate a brand-new standalone transparent WebP-ready asset: an elegant isometric/neumorphic miniature Greater Toronto Area map baseplate made of warm off-white paper/clay material, with subtle embossed roads, soft relief grid lines, small rounded trees, tiny low-rise model blocks, canals, shoreline, and pale blue water along the lower edge. Preserve the soft premium Fairlend landing-page lighting, warm shadows, shallow depth, and refined 3D diorama feel. Keep the asset clean and usable behind live UI: no text labels, no route line, no red pins, no UI cards, no icons, no buttons, no house hero object, no skyline/CN Tower, no brand marks. Isolated subject on a perfectly flat #ff00ff chroma-key background for alpha removal, with generous padding and no cast shadow onto the background.
generation.negative_prompt: Do not include screenshot pixels, page chrome, Fairlend logo, navigation, CTAs, typography, cards, red route path, red markers, city labels, house, goal card, Toronto skyline, CN Tower, people, watermark, or border.

assets.label: Toronto cityscape
assets.role: Transparent isometric Toronto skyline asset for web composition
assets.rationale: The skyline, CN Tower, stadium dome, miniature buildings, trees, lighting, and shadows are a complex generated 3D illustration best handled as a standalone raster asset.

generation.prompt: Use the reference crop only as style guidance. Generate a brand-new standalone transparent WebP-ready asset: a refined isometric miniature Toronto cityscape in warm off-white clay/paper material, including a recognizable CN Tower on the right, clustered downtown high-rises, a smooth white domed stadium, scattered rounded trees, low-rise blocks, and soft golden rooftop highlights. Match the premium neumorphic Fairlend landing-page aesthetic: soft studio lighting from upper left, gentle ambient occlusion, realistic miniature shadows, clean elegant forms, subtle beige/cream material variation. Isolate only the skyline/cityscape subject on a perfectly flat #ff00ff chroma-key background for alpha removal, with generous padding and no floor/background beyond the city base.
